description: This file defines the EditTagDialog class, a dialog component for editing or creating tags within the app. It manages user input for tag names, checks for existing tags, and interacts with the TagDialogViewModel to update or insert tags.

classes.name: EditTagDialog
classes.description: A dialog for editing or creating tags, extending BaseDialog with a specific binding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, retrieves the Tag object from arguments.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Creates and inflates the dialog's view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures the dialog UI based on whether a tag is being edited or created, sets up button actions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the dialog with an optional Tag argument.
